findings.preconditions: Signed-in owner with station and actual discovery candidates; ordinary owner play and thumb-up keep actions; change station source to already-imported liked source while kept discoveries remain
reproduction: onboarded tracks600/playlists300; run ordinary discovery alarms for3h
Play generated station deck; start actual discovery via Spotify-client playlist position; listen5min; capture nonignored history row kind discovery
Keep first and second actual discovery via thumb; listen to second5min; set station sources to liked (empty imported source), preserving kept pool
Enable guest, explicit newQueue plans new round with two kept songs as fresh; start first at actual playlist position
Poll actual state live+refresh every30s until guest replay completes; disable guest; read original owner row
findings.expected: Old owner row retains discovery reason or becomes null when exact provenance is unavailable
findings.actual: Old owner row becomes fresh by borrowing later guest occurrence within2h; it is nonignored and client renders Aus der Kassette instead of Empfehlung
findings.cause: historyKinds uses track+station and absolute2h proximity without proving matching occurrence or deck generation
findings.repair_direction: Return null unless a current deck item proves this exact stored play (e.g. exact played stamp); remove approximate cross-occurrence borrowing without introducing incidental state writes
findings.required_regression: Run final-owner-repro test against repair; earlier nonignored play must not relabel after later guest/newQueue occurrence; retain live exact provenance and read-only invariants
